summary: Verified all invoice format changes are working correctly. Backend API returns total_deposits field, client_deposits list, and all required fields. Frontend UI displays new column format (CANTIDAD, DETALLE, COSTO, TIENDA, COMISION, TOTAL), summary stats (Total de artículos, Total Etiqueta, Peso en Libras), and financial summary (Subtotal, Taxes, Envio, Total, Abonos, Total a pagar). PDF download button is present and enabled.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing invoices INV-000001 and INV-000002 for client Juan Perez (J2934)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Invoice format changes verified working. Two invoices exist: INV-000002 (1 item, no shipment, $10.00) and INV-000001 (10 items, with shipment $35.00, 5.5 lbs, total $240.04). Client Juan Perez has 4 approved deposits totaling $130.00 shown as Abonos.

new_column_headers.details: Table shows CANTIDAD, DETALLE, COSTO, TIENDA, COMISION, TOTAL columns

total_calculation.details: TOTAL = price + commission (NOT including tax). Example: Zapatos Nike $45.99 + $3.00 = $48.99

summary_stats_section.details: Shows Total de artículos (count), Total Etiqueta (sum of COSTO/subtotal), Peso en Libras (weight from shipment)

financial_summary.details: Shows Subtotal, Taxes, Envio (shipping), Total, Abonos (individual deposits), Total a pagar

total_deposits_api_field.details: Backend /api/invoices/{id} returns total_deposits field with sum of all approved deposits

client_deposits_list.details: Backend returns client_deposits array for displaying individual Abonos

saldo_anterior.details: Saldo Anterior only shows when client_balance > 0 (not shown in test as balance was 0)

total_a_pagar_calculation.details: Total a pagar = max(0, Grand Total - total_deposits). INV-000001: $240.04 - $130.00 = $110.04

pdf_download_button.details: PDF download button present and enabled in invoice dialog

shipment_info_display.details: Invoice with shipment shows INFORMACIÓN DE ENVÍO section with Costo de Envío, Peso, and Tracking

tests: Returns list of invoices with basic info
Returns all required fields for new format
Returns purchases with price, commission, store, item_name
